applicability: any reviewed component where the reviewer can enumerate unbounded 'what if this input is hostile' instances

evidence.environment: static review of scripts/workflow_contract.py and scripts/fleet_records.py
evidence.source_reference: PR #125 Codex review rounds at heads 1d86e9e, 6b0929e, 225ecf5, 9db2aea

expected_behavior: When review findings cite the previous fix and name an adjacent unchecked instance, treat the class as the defect rather than the field: add one shape table covering every field plus a table-driven test that drives each with a wrong type, so a future omission surfaces as a missing table row instead of a crash.
observation: Three consecutive review rounds raised ill-typed-input findings whose own text cited the previous round's fix ('beyond the prior endpoint fix, kind still reaches a set lookup unchecked'; 'after the malformed-cluster fix, not malformed object fields'). Each field-level isinstance patch left the next unchecked field as the next round's finding, so the round count did not converge on correctness.
